description: Implement DHA-style header navigation and white/green theme. Replace existing header with SEMA logo (left), single 'Dashboard' tab, and Logout button (right). Apply white background with green accent colors (#10b981, green-600) throughout. Implement click handlers: logo click scrolls to top, Dashboard click scrolls to top, Logout button calls useAuth().logout() and navigates to landing page.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001.json to understand requirements

Replace the entire navigation header section in SEMADashboardComplete.tsx (lines ~108-135) with: white background, SEMA logo + Activity icon on left, single 'Dashboard' navigation tab in center/left area, Logout button with LogOut icon on right using green-600 background

Update all color references: change current green-900/green-800 gradient backgrounds to green-600/green-700, ensure stat card accent colors use green-100 backgrounds with green-600 icons (replacing mixed purple/indigo), update all buttons to use green-600 hover:green-700

Implement three click handlers: scrollToTop function for logo, scrollToTop function for Dashboard tab, handleLogout function that calls logout() from useAuth() context then sets window.location.href = '/' to return to landing page

Update hero section (lines ~138-170) to use white text on green-600/green-700 gradient background with proper contrast, update breadcrumb to show 'Home / Dashboard', change title from 'National SEMA Overview' to 'National CHU Overview', update subtitle to mention Community Health Units

Clicking Dashboard tab scrolls page to top smoothly
Clicking Logout button logs user out and returns to landing page (CompleteLandingPage)
Hero section displays 'National CHU Overview' title with Community Health Unit context
verification: npm run build:check passes with no TypeScript errors
Start dev server with npm run dev, login with admin@safaricom.co.ke / admin123
Verify header shows only logo, Dashboard, and Logout button
Click logo and Dashboard - both scroll to top
